description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Voracious Wurm. Voracious Wurm enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
Activate Voracious Wurm using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
